notes.title: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault is coming to Steam in 2025!
notes.content:
Greetings, merchants!

We are so thrilled to announce Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault, the long-awaited continuation to our shopkeeping roguelite and Digital Sun’s first-ever sequel. Grab your trusty backpack, fill it with hype, and meet a new Will in our 4K reveal trailer, which premiered tonight at the PC Gaming Show.

[previewyoutube=uZW8MwekNHk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Coming to Steam in 2025[/h3]

While delivering the beloved blend of dungeon-crawling and shopkeeping gameplay, Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault elevates the series with expanded scope and refined quality in every aspect.

[b]Add Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault to your wishlist and stay updated![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2350790/

[h3]About the Game[/h3]

Step back into the life of intrepid adventurer and crafty merchant Will! Embrace your inner hero as you journey through vibrant, ever-changing dimensions brimming with loot, enemies, and traps. Max out your gains by strategically arranging the treasures within your packsack and unleashing countless effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28578670/5c7d5762ab081b380a46cfe29463804fdf1a3d6a.gif[/img]

Back at your homey shop, haggle for the best deals while handling unexpected messes. Grow your store’s charm with decorations and take advantage of temporary perks to make every transaction smoother.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28578670/1bc763735c8f432a92473fd0af55fed72161bf2f.gif[/img]

Invest your hard-earned coins into enhancing your shop and gear so each expedition grows ever more fruitful. That’s how you will thrive in the blob-brimming land of Tresna!

[h3]Follow the merchant[/h3]

Spill the beans on the trailer, and share your thoughts with fellow fans on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/BFWrAfxd2H]Discord[/url], [url=https://x.com/DigitalSunGames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Moonlighter/]Reddit[/url] and the Steam forum.

For more details, check our Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault FAQ. We will unveil more details and sneak peeks in the following updates.

See you in Tresna!
Digital Sun & 11 bit studios

notes.title: Introducing the newsfeed! Follow us and receive this adorable birdie
notes.content:
Greetings, Heroes and Merchants!

[h1]Look at this birdie![/h1]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28578670/92786ef7ff97f5af9715f805071d72a8713549cd.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28578670/92786ef7ff97f5af9715f805071d72a8713549cd.gif[/img][/url]

Want this pal in front of your shop? [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/digitalsun]Follow Digital Sun on Steam[/url], and it’ll pay you a visit!*

Perhaps you’ve read about him on [b]Moonlighter’s newsfeed[/b], the other major addition to this update. When launching the game, you’ll see a curated selection of news about our games.

We’ll keep it nice and simple. [b]Only major beats[/b] will be included in the newsfeed, like announcing a new title, premiering a new trailer, or releasing a game. Needless to say, all Moonlighter-related news will appear here, too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28578670/8c80049796207a4ac0601ad4c822aa0f9376a182.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28578670/fcbe78f27f7f2ddd34bdaf0018709ad5811345a3.png[/img]
Please [b]ensure to open the news[/b] and follow our account from there, or the bird won’t appear!

[h1]Why are we doing this? [/h1]

Well, the newsfeed is just another way to connect with our fans and keep you all posted about our future.

In an industry in which lay-offs and closures are so widely spread, making good games is no longer enough. [b]We need our fans right at our side[/b] to forge an ever-lasting community that supports and enjoys our work.

Having that said, we don’t want to be spammy. Feel free to disable the newsfeed from the settings. But don’t forget that you still can hear from us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/BFWrAfxd2H]our Discord server[/url]!

See you in Rynoka.
Israel - Fellow Shopkeeper

notes.title: Making New Marks | 11 bit studios Publishing Announcement
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989971/155999effbf15f900f31aefc93ce7977ec4a3037.jpg[/img]

Hi there, Community!

[h1][b]We have some super exciting news for you![/b][/h1]

We are proud to [b]team up once again with the developers of Moonlighter and take on an ambitious project from Fool’s Theory[/b]! Both projects -- in various stages of development with further details coming in 2020 and beyond -- are bigger in scope than anything 11 bit has previously published.

“We’re still an extremely picky publisher. We’re probably even pickier than we were before if you can believe it! Our job is to hand-pick true gems and put our best efforts in with the development teams to help make them shine. We believe in boosting unique projects and using all the marketing magic we have to see them succeed. Right now, we’ve got two projects we’re really proud to have under our wing,” - Pawel Feldman, Publishing Director at 11 bit studios.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989971/e63174a32b352ec748ef8d8f4a5238aea84b4920.jpg[/img]

Details are sparse right now (gotta save all that marketing magic for later), but we can reveal the following:[list]
[*] We are beyond thrilled to be teaming up with Poland-based Fool’s Theory for their latest project, codenamed Vitriol. The studio behind the artfully created stealth title, [i]Seven: The Days Long Gone[/i], is developing a game best described as a meaningful RPG. Jakub Rokosz, CEO at Fool’s Theory says, “We are truly happy to align with 11 bit studios. They’re known for their ability to find the unique spirit in a game and I believe our upcoming title fits impeccably with the type of projects they like to work on.”
[*] You might also say that we are ‘over the Moon(lighter)’ to be teaming up once more with Digital Sun Games. There’s nothing to divulge just yet, but rest assured that the hard-working Spanish developer is putting the same care and attention into their new project (codename Foxhole) as they did with their critically acclaimed indie hit, Moonlighter, but this time it’s a totally new IP. “We badly wanted to work with these guys again. As a team, we feel 11 bit did a great job with Moonlighter and we both want to do even better things together. It’s really as simple as that, ” says Javier Gimenez, CEO at Digital Sun Games.
[/list]

And if you're willing to look for more clues, here's a short but [b]very mysterious video[/b]: 
https://youtu.be/0xR4XkeOqao
We're very much excited for the things to come. We hope you're sharing this excitement with us now! Stay tuned!

notes.title: Children of Morta | RELEASE DATE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989971/4da414f87fd53bf88bdc8abf55ab0aab72236428.jpg[/img]

Hi there, Community!

[h1][b]We have some pretty amazing news for you today![/b][/h1]

[b]Children of Morta will be arriving on PC this September 3, 2019. The Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, and PlayStation 4 versions of the game will launch on October 15, 2019. [/b]To celebrate the launch date announcement, you can check out the all-new trailer below.

[h1][b]Watch our brand-new "It Runs in the Family" trailer here:[/b][/h1]
https://youtu.be/_oapcHvc6UQ
[h1][b]About the game:[/b][/h1]
Corruption has spread, morphing the once peaceful Mount Morta into a violent and monster-infested nightmare. Will you be able to sacrifice everything to save the ones you care for? Children of Morta is a story-driven action RPG about a valiant family standing together while the world around them is devoured in darkness. Lead the Bergsons, with all their flaws and virtues, and experience what it means to be in a family of heroes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989971/cb35ca8aaa12e739afa0d4cb0778517d7c23c405.gif[/img]

Children of Morta copes with themes closer to our daily lives than one would expect. notes.title: Moonlighter | Friends and Foes (Update 1.9)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28578670/f43d6d5166d6dcdf67965124a69bb78c2a55bd7c.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Hello there, Heroes and Merchants![/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Moonlighter’s Friends & Foes Update is here just in time for Valentine’s Day - 'cause nothing says LOVE like strengthening bonds through monster slaying.[/b][/h1]

Someone smart said that a true friendship is born at that moment when one person says to another: [b]“Let’s slay some monsters together!”[/b]. And even though our freshly [b]introduced 9 familiars[/b] cannot really talk - they are more than happy to aid you during the most dangerous endeavors. To counterbalance that, though, we’ve also added [b]brand new ferocious minibosses[/b] - so we’re hoping that you and your new companions are getting on well with each other, you’re gonna need all the help you can get! On top of that, we’ve added plenty of other features and fixes - find a Feature Overview video and the full list of changes below!
https://youtu.be/spd-mDqqRD8

[h1][b]NEW FEATURES AND MAJOR CHANGES
[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Companions[/b][/h1]
We have developed 9 new familiars. To get them, you need to kill a particular enemy type 10 times. Then, a special Egg will appear! After 3 days, the egg will hatch inside your farm - and your new friend is going to be ready for action! Each familiar has different mechanics. They can damage enemies, restore your life, get items for you, act as an additional chest and more

[h1][b]Minibosses[/b][/h1]
We have added 8 minibosses! They will appear as guardians of the dungeons, securing gateways leading to deeper rooms. They will emerge at the end of the first and second floor in each dungeon.

[h1][b]Zenon’s Campfire[/b][/h1]
From now on, when you visit the dungeons at night, Zenon will be there, sitting by his campfire, ready to tell you some stories of old, about Rynoka and Moonlighter’s world. Those tales will be unlocked with the game’s progression.

[h1][b]Tomo Stories[/b][/h1]
We've modified and added more lines for Tomo. They should explain her relationship with Will better, shedding some light on their mutual past.

[h1][b]Banker Information[/b][/h1]
We have introduced a lot of special warnings and UI changes to avoid the Banker "stealing" your money. A lot of you forgot to revisit that mustachioed capitalist and were losing the investment.

[h1][b]Sorting Items[/b][/h1]
We've added a sorting method inside the inventory.

[h1][b]Get the Broom![/b][/h1]
We’ve added the possibility to get the Broom™ from Le Retailer (if you’ve managed to lose it somehow!). The Broom™ is important for getting some achievements - so we hope you’re gonna like that little feature!

[h1][b]Prices Update[/b][/h1]
We’ve added a new system in the Shop to better inform whenever Item’s price gets updated.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28578670/cc634b0631ff89110522ca1fdd2bc031b833c734.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]MINOR CHANGES AND FIXES[/b][/h1]

[b]General Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved item "picking-up" mechanic. Items should no longer "fly away" from Will
[*] Damage absorption buff (orange health bar) gained from sleeping in the upgraded bed was increased in the New game+
[*] Fixed issue where some weapons could not be enchanted beyond the first upgrade
[*] [b](Steam Only)[/b] - Supporter Bow no longer can be enchanted over and over
[*] Fixed issue where Wishlist could display wrong information about ingredients when an item was added to it at the Witch
[*] Fixed issue with ingredients for weapon enchanting
[*] Fixed minor issue with Hawker item prices
[*] Fixed minor UI issues at the Witch and Wishlist
[*] Fixed minor localization issues
[/list]
[h1][b]Dungeon Fixes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Desert dungeon pillars should no longer lock the player in the dungeon room
[*] Hermit Slime no longer can mix up corrupted dungeon items in the character's inventory
[*] An issue where Bard Puppet could become invincible (flying golem from the Desert Dungeon) is now finally fixed
[*] Character no longer gets stuck when opening a chest when the Wanderer (green monster) is about to destroy it
[*] Golem Dungeon Boss' hand slam attack should now follow the character properly
[*] Fixed issue where 5th Dungeon Boss did not receive damage from arrows during one animation
[*] Fixed Forest Dungeon Boss' leap attack damage
[/list]
[h1][b]Shop Fixes:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Will could get stuck in the shop not able to open counters, sleep or exit through the door
[/list]
[h1][b]Important notice: we've worked hard to make this Update available simultaneously for all the platforms (Xbox One, PlayStation 4, Nintendo Switch, PC etc.).[/b][/h1] However, it may be available during different hours for various platforms. So don't panic if you notice this update on PC but not on your console at the same time! All versions should be synchronized later today.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Moonlighter - Update 1.6 | Time is Money
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28578670/5968992285c5f0286d676b7a1c1b742a92a21a5a.jpg[/img]

Hello there, Merchants and Heroes!

We're bringing you a brand new patch (1.6) that we've called Time is Money - 'cause it is mostly focused on Shop and Village features. On top of that - we have also fixed a lot of other stuff so the overall experience should be even more enjoyable for everyone!

[h1][b] - - - MAJOR CHANGES - - -[/b][/h1][olist]
[*][b][u]New Items' Popularity System![/u][/b] 
We've received a lot of feedback about game's economy and decided to adjust that. This is one of the biggest changes introduced to our game so far - 'cause it really alters the general feeling of Moonlighter's economy. Popularity system now highly affects when people decide buy or don't buy items. Better be prepared to actively swap those items so your shop can prosper! Also, from now on, Rich and Tourist type of customers can buy from any place, not only the crystal showcases. We've also modified the crystal showcases themselves: every item you put there is going to have an increased popularity level and it's going to be protected from those pesky thieves!
[*][b]Last used price is now saved[/b] 
Ok, we admit: that was kind of annoying. Every time you were putting a price for a new item - it always went back to zero until you sold it. This was also frustrating with thieves, because you could forget the price you used. Now, if you don't know the good price, the system will remember the last price you've set. Yay!
[*][b]Improved Horde Room[/b] 
We have improved the animations for this room and it works slightly different. Now, for every "round" inside the Horde Room you will have to select: open the chest or keep fighting? So you won't be able to open all the chests anymore. We believe it adds a little bit more risk and spices up the experience.
[*][b]Buying multiple Potions[/b] 
A highly requested feature, indeed! Now you can buy up to 99 potions at the same time from the Witch![/olist]

[*]Wanderer can no longer be spawned outside of the map
[*]Wanderer no longer gets stuck on obstacles

[*]Tech Dungeon: Improved Death Generator behavior during fight
[*]Forest Dungeon: Game no longer freezes in one specific room

[*]Items sent home from the Dungeon do not disappear upon exiting the game[/list]

[*]Items from previous sale will no longer be displayed on sales summary if the game was quit before closing the shop
[*]Fixed Soft lock on opening pause menu during tutorial[/list]

[*]Soft lock upon interacting with the Witch
[*]Soft Lock upon crafting weapon/armor at the Blacksmith
[*][OS X] Game crash when character is enveloped by Slime and character's health reaches 0
[*]It is no longer possible to get stuck inside Townboard or Witch's Wooden Hat 
[*]No longer possible to control character during credits
[*]GUI does not appear during final cinematic
[*]Missing Space between Will and GUI sections in controls
[/list]
We're still working on more updates, of course - and some really big and cool ones are heading your way! And folks, as always, don't hesitate to contact us - to report any issues and share cool ideas! We really appreciate your feedback!

Thank you for your ongoing support!

notes.title: Moonlighter | Development Roadmap 2018 Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28578670/9948ee0f9bbcbc92215ffa7f1eeeb7155ca2a0be.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello there, Heroes and Merchants![/b]

We believe that a good adventure always requires a little bit of old-fashioned planning and - obviously - [b]a map![/b] A map that will lead you to your goal. Is there a treasure waiting at the end of the road? Perhaps a princess or a prince? A golden armor for your horse? You do you, we won’t judge - but we have prepared something else and very special: [b]Moonlighter Development Roadmap for 2018![/b]

Feedback that we have received from you so far has been - yes, pretty overwhelming - but also: beyond amazing! You guys have some crazy good ideas and guess what - we have some as well! And you know what always works best? Cooperation! So, we’ve collected your feedback and [b]we have incorporated it into our development plan[/b]. Therefore, after many internal discussions, hours of research and drinking non-alcoholic beverages - [b]we proudly present you Moonlighter Development Roadmap 2018[/b]:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28578670/aaeacfccf29d074ceb73f88238ed0c6cbbb217f3.png[/img]
[url=http://moonlighterthegame.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/07/roadmap5-1.png][i]Click here to see the full resolution[/i][/url]

Excited? So we share that feeling! Let us give you a little bit more information about each milestone from the Roadmap. Not everything, though - we like to keep some secrets. Oh, and this should go without saying - [b]but all the updates that you see on this Roadmap are going to be totally free[/b]! Still waiting for the full confirmation - the Winter DLC is supposed to be paid DLC so we have to be careful with wording.

[h1][b]- - - ROADMAP DETAILS - - -[/b][/h1]

[b][u]More Stock Update[/u][/b]

Our first update will [b]add more than 50 new rooms distributed all over the four dungeons[/b], making a total of [b]almost 600 room patterns available[/b]! It’s also going to improve the look of armors and enchanted items, plus we plan to add some additional small help/tutorials to explain different shop upgrades better.

[b][u]Adventure Update[/u][/b]

[b]New Game+[/b] lets players start the whole game again with increased difficulty level. This update will also bring brand new [b]Dimensional Weapons and Amulets[/b], equipment based on some mysterious technology.

[b][u]Companion Update[/u][/b]

Feeling lonely in the Dungeons? Worry no more! [b]Choose a companion and bring it with you on the adventure[/b]! Each companion will be a little bit different, offering various skill sets and looks. On top of that we’re going to introduce [b]the Custom Game[/b]: a set of options that will allow you to to modify some game parameters to create diverse experiences.

[b][u]Trouble Update[/u][/b]

Put your skills to the test by battling some brand new [b]mini bosses[/b]! We’re not going to tell you anything more about them - ‘cause we want those enemies to surprise (and brutally defeat) you during your adventures. Yup, we are mean like that sometimes. We are also going to add some new [b]Item Effects[/b] - boosting game’s variety. This update should arrive somewhen around [b]Halloween - so we’re hoping to bring you some spoOOoky stuff[/b], too!

That should cover the basics! However, as said before - [b]we don’t want to spoil everything[/b] - so we can keep you on the edge of the chair while you wait for upcoming content! And yes - [b]we have more updates planned for 2019[/b]!

[h1][b]- - - MEET DIGITAL SUN Games - - -[/b][/h1]

Breaking news: games are not creating themselves. At least not yet. There are always people behind your favourite titles. And even though we are bunch of super secret ninjas working from València, focused on delivering a quality game to your hands - we would like to show you our faces from time to time. Along with the folks from 11 bit studios we’ve created a short dev diary that can give you a small sneak peek on how we work. [b]Our studios are connected like a large family - and we invite you to become part of this family as well[/b]:

notes.content:

Hello there, fellow Citizens of Rynoka! 

It's update time! You've sent us A LOT of feedback. This helped us not only with bug-elimination but also with improving the game itself - so we are very thankful for your help!

[h1][b]- - - GENERAL PATCH NOTES - - -[/b][/h1][olist]
[*][b]Key binding improvements[/b] (some extra freedom and mouse button support). We might continue to improve this, let us know if this helps a little.
[*]Bug fixing, as much as possible as soon as possible after our release. There will still be bugs but we will keep working, your feedback has been super helpful. Thank you!
[*]We've added a special logging system to the game that will allow you to send us more information when something crazy happens, so we can find and smash those dirty bugs.
[*]Other minor improvements (mostly following requests from you and/or our own ideas)[/olist]

[h1][b]- - - IMPROVEMENTS - - -[/b][/h1][list]
[*][b]Key binding now allows for independent binding of each key[/b] separating Will actions and GUI actions on both Keyboard, Mouse Buttons and Controllers
[*]There is a “default key binding” available
[*]Now sleep is activated by holding the action button[/list]
So - yeah. We've listened to your feedback and [b]now you can totally redefine your controls the way you like it[/b]. No limitations - as we're all different and we like to play games our own way. However, we have a layout to propose, that you may want to give a try. [b]This is a special layout loved by our QA department[/b] and here it is:

[h1][b]- - - BUG FIXES - - -[/b][/h1]

As far as we know - we solved below issues completely - but if some of them still persist - please let us know.

[*]Solved several problems with closing the shop mechanics
[*]Problems closing the main menu after using pendant
[*]Several problems related to quests givers
[*]General memory leak related to something called “materials” that might be behind several other issues.

notes.title: Shop till you drop! Moonlighter got "content lock"!​ [UPDATE]
notes.content:
Hi there, everyone!

It’s been some time since the last update so: big apologies! We’re in the last stages of the development of the game, and almost all our efforts are on finishing the best game possible. 

[h1][u][b]Contents of this update:[/b][/u][/h1][list]
[*]All Moonlighter content is done! (But there is still work to do...) 
[*]An introduction to the Shop Mechanics 
[*]General Moonlighter FAQ[/list]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/785/cc044492df01a66b658e787d8996f75f_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1519299816&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=c9f8a2ef2dd0e4caf29d0a5e3ffbeb53[/img]
We are very proud to say that, after several years of work (around 3,5 years!), [b]the core development of Moonlighter is done[/b]! There still is some stuff to do before you can have the game in your hands but the major part of the effort is already behind us!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/791/931b8436c14c3eb853316321f0963abd_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1519299837&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=2186e6f092b223f9bdabfdfd0f113a93[/img]

[h1][u][b]This means that:[/b][/u][/h1][list]
[*][b]All gameplay content is done[/b]! Will fights, trades, crafts, sleeps and meets new people all the way through the game until solving the mystery of The 5th Gate.  
[*]Every pixel moves in the right direction when told, and has the right color.  
The music is loud when it should be, and mesmerizing when needed, all thanks to David Fenn. 
[*]All four dungeons are done, with three unique floors on each and big bad boss at the end.  
[*]Almost 50 different kinds of enemies await for Will in the depths of the dungeons.
[*]Secret and special rooms are now 99% bug free! (ok, maybe 98%...)  
[*]Our random “fancy overpriced item name generator” for Le Retailer (Will’s rival merchant) is finished and working in full power.  
[*]Each sword swing, step, and deep breath now sounds as expected, thanks to the work of Alex Benet.  
[*]The 5th Gate now actually has something behind it… awaiting for Will.
[*]The Witch sells potions and enchant items at just the right prices, brewing those is more effort than you might think...
[*]All texts are in place, in the following languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Polish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazilian), Chinese. Only the Spanish translation and some minor stuff is still under progress. Yeah, our own language was the last one... Priorities… Btw, this is the awesome name of Moonlighter in Korean: 문라이터 !!
[*]The options menu is finished and allows you to do things like setting the difficulty of the game between normal, hard, or [b]very[/b] hard.[/list]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/782/e885678d1306773ac043ce1b9006f6f4_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1519299792&auto=format&lossless=true&s=7a3fb0ed6adc7cc906f4700325ca5d7c[/img]
 
[h1][u][b]Now, we still need to:[/b][/u][/h1][list] 
[*]Fix minor bugs here and there on the PC version of the game (we don’t have almost any major bug on PC).
[*]Final debugging of console ports. The game is already playable from beginning to end on Xbox One, PS4 and almost there on Nintendo Switch, but it still needs some more work before starting the certification process. [*]This is the major point pending, it’s a lot of work, but we are very close to finish and things are looking good.
[*]Creating some cool trailers.. With some background story (anyone wants to see Will as a kid?) :)[/list]
It’s a lot of work to build a game like Moonlighter and we really appreciate the support we are receiving, we are very close finish and we are really looking forward for the day you can all play the game.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/722/5596417f1b42472209ce1e8d2e7134a0_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1519299252&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=dcd1f121a59637c37dc328d66865d8b4[/img]
 
We feel we never gave Will’s shop (Moonlighter), the attention it deserves on previous updates. And, in many aspects, it’s the heart of game. So, here is a quick summary of all the [b]shop mechanics[/b]:   

[h1][u][b]Price mechanics[/b][/u][/h1]
When will finds a new item in the dungeons he doesn’t know the exact value of the item, so he needs to try to find the right prize by judging the reactions of the customers. You don’t want to sell too cheap, but you also don’t want to be greedy…

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/807/43e211d12c1a58bf1c42eab1a7247877_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1519299960&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=d2d264f49bf76cb956e342e6bd14db8f[/img]


[h1][u][b]Item popularity[/b][/u][/h1]
Selling a lot of an item, or selling an item slightly overpriced, will reduce the popularity of that item making it harder to sell at a decent price, or even impossible to sell. With time, the popularity will return to normality for every item.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/808/7b679adbcbd47d26140da583acd39dc5_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1519299985&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=88a77d164d176f692eab6b5b89f62cae[/img]


[h1][u][b]Thieves[/b][/u][/h1]
One of the side effects of being greedy is that some shady “customers” might be tempted to steal from you. Thankfully, Will, used to face way more dangerous foes, is more than prepared to deal with these individuals.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/809/e727a91b1c0b8b6e844a352ed55613f5_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1519300002&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=b1c5fa429b3da7a061d6a7d2c635f7b0[/img]


[h1][u][b]Home / Shop improvements[/b][/u][/h1]
Will can invest some of his hard earned gold in improvements for his shop: Moonlighter. As the game progresses, it is possible to expand the shop. Larger versions will have more showcases, more space to place decorations and more chests to store items. Also, it is possible to invest in other aspects of the shop like a larger storage chest, a better bed (resting is important for moonlighters!) or a useful “sales box”.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/811/deda07ac7d8d9ba24418ea8a99e88d46_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1519300029&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=a0d8d9f4c8212922fe8184ee3ebc1de9[/img]


[h1][u][b]Shop decorations[/b][/u][/h1]
Once Will proves that there is something going on in Rynoka again, it will be possible to attract a very special merchant to Rynoka: The Hawker. This well traveled trader sells some fancy decorations that customers love! Placing them in your shop will modify some shop stats like the customers inclination to pay some extra gold, or the amount of customers you can receive during a day… Having a beautiful shop is great on itself, sure, but it’s also good for business!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/322/051/9304dc766de927d70829ade83150e6dd_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1519302607&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=ed34579b9379b56aec2a92fa05a9c1f2[/img]


[h1][u][b]Sales report[/b][/u][/h1]
Recently, we added a report that summarizes the sales everytime you close the shop. We felt it was important to see clearly how productive the day was!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/813/a32a9784e37c8336f71f750c49f07266_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1519300065&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=8f383448758d8360c3ee0fc62bba80b6[/img]


[h1][u][b]Requests[/b][/u][/h1]
As the game progresses, Will’s customers will be a little more sophisticated. Some of them will come to your shop with a request for a very specific item in mind. They will come back at a specific date and, if Will can deliver the request, they will be very generous...

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/817/a2e013c6abc2c1a728e7e8bc84d34fae_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1519300084&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=259836b39a37dbcaf44f93871e945ce5[/img]


[h1][u][b]Shop manager[/b][/u][/h1]
In the later stages of the game, Will tends to spend more and more time in the dungeons, as he gets closer to opening the 5th door. At this point, some help can come in handy, which is why we included a new character: the shop manager. She is a experienced shopkeeper that can be hired as extra help on very busy shops. The manager can be very efficient in obtaining the best value for the items and also in dissuading thieves, allowing Will to focus on crossing The 5th Gate!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/819/03a64eaccdbfc2fb0f0545a433b8825c_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1519300108&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=65142237a377cc36579c3bfabbf9872b[/img]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/762/e11a77c56c4a00e49ba6a4bb131ac055_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1519299603&auto=format&lossless=true&s=9edd6e8718b22c64b439c1092dc91147[/img]
  
[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/748/6f5a61a5da630837669ec856e3a7c68d_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1519299451&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=353c8cb393688f5eae50390620c448f9[/img]

Now, we know you still have a lot of questions. We hope this helps:

[b]When is the game going to be released?[/b]

Well, as soon as we feel it’s ready, which should be pretty soon. We worked so hard on Moonlighter that we wouldn’t want to rush it and give you something not polished or poorly balanced. We were aiming at a Q1 2018 release (and that was already a delay from previous goals) but it probably won’t be possible given the complexity of debugging and polishing the game on all platforms. At the same time, there isn’t that much work pending so we should be ready in a very few months.

[b]If the game content is ready, why don’t you release the game already on PC?[/b]

The game content is finished but that doesn’t mean that it’s 100% bug-free (though it’s already very stable). Also, even if we had a PC version ready to release, it’s much better for us, as an indie studio, to release simultaneously on all platforms. It gives the game more marketing visibility, something that we can’t simply “purchase” like huge companies. We want to increase the chances of Moonlighter selling well on all platforms: It’s going to be very important so we can continue to create games for all of you!

[b]Are you going to attend game shows in the following months?[/b]

Yes! We’ll be at PAX East and GDC,. For those around Valencia (our hometown, in Spain), we’ll also attend the “Valencia Indie Summit” on the 1st and 2nd of March. Come say hello!

[b]How is the team’s morale?[/b]

It’s staying high! Working hard for such a long time is, of course, tiring, but we are very excited about the current state of the game, and we really hope you like it. We feel that the hard work and love we invested really shows and it’s a high quality, fun and charismatic, indie game. We can’t wait to listen to what you think about it!

[b]Any new about the Switch version?[/b]

We have received all your payments, and we will process the platform changes gradually. Currently everything is being set up, so don’t worry: You will receive your Nintendo Switch code on time!

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/762/e11a77c56c4a00e49ba6a4bb131ac055_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1519299603&auto=format&lossless=true&s=9edd6e8718b22c64b439c1092dc91147[/img]

And that’s all for now! As always, feel free to contact us via mail, direct message on Twitter, and via anything else :) We will respond you as soon as possible.

Best regards,
Digital Sun & 11 bit studios

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/791/931b8436c14c3eb853316321f0963abd_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1519299837&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=2186e6f092b223f9bdabfdfd0f113a93[/img]

[*][b]All gameplay content is done[/b]! Will fights, trades, crafts, sleeps and meets new people all the way through the game until solving the mystery of The 5th Gate.  
[*]Every pixel moves in the right direction when told, and has the right color.  
The music is loud when it should be, and mesmerizing when needed, all thanks to David Fenn. 
[*]All four dungeons are done, with three unique floors on each and big bad boss at the end.  
[*]Almost 50 different kinds of enemies await for Will in the depths of the dungeons.
[*]Secret and special rooms are now 99% bug free! (ok, maybe 98%...)  
[*]Our random “fancy overpriced item name generator” for Le Retailer (Will’s rival merchant) is finished and working in full power.  
[*]Each sword swing, step, and deep breath now sounds as expected, thanks to the work of Alex Benet.  
[*]The 5th Gate now actually has something behind it… awaiting for Will.
[*]The Witch sells potions and enchant items at just the right prices, brewing those is more effort than you might think...
[*]All texts are in place, in the following languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Polish, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazilian), Chinese. [img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/782/e885678d1306773ac043ce1b9006f6f4_original.png?w=639&fit=max&v=1519299792&auto=format&lossless=true&s=7a3fb0ed6adc7cc906f4700325ca5d7c[/img]
 
[h1][u][b]Now, we still need to:[/b][/u][/h1][list] 
[*]Fix minor bugs here and there on the PC version of the game (we don’t have almost any major bug on PC).
[*]Final debugging of console ports. The game is already playable from beginning to end on Xbox One, PS4 and almost there on Nintendo Switch, but it still needs some more work before starting the certification process. Selling a lot of an item, or selling an item slightly overpriced, will reduce the popularity of that item making it harder to sell at a decent price, or even impossible to sell. With time, the popularity will return to normality for every item.

Also, it is possible to invest in other aspects of the shop like a larger storage chest, a better bed (resting is important for moonlighters!) or a useful “sales box”.

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/020/321/811/deda07ac7d8d9ba24418ea8a99e88d46_original.gif?w=639&fit=max&v=1519300029&auto=format&gif-q=50&q=92&s=a0d8d9f4c8212922fe8184ee3ebc1de9[/img]

notes.title: Become a Hero!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28578670/9c8ec27d0c58c5e35874f465de947bf03bb4586e.gif[/img]

Hi there, everyone!

You may be wondering [b]"what is Moonlighter?"[/b]. So, here's a quick explanation:

[h1][b][u]SETTING:[/u][/b][/h1]
During an archeological excavation – a set of Gates were discovered. People quickly realized that these ancient passages lead to different realms and dimensions. Rynoka, a small commercial village, was found near the excavation site – providing brave and reckless adventurers with treasures beyond measure.

[b]Moonlighter is an Action RPG with rogue-lite elements[/b] that demonstrates two sides of the coin – revealing everyday routines of Will, an adventurous shopkeeper that secretly dreams of becoming a hero.

[h1][b][u]FEATURES:[/u][/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Manage your Shop[/b][/h1]
While conducting your business in Rynoka village, you can put items on sale, set their price carefully, manage gold reserves, recruit assistants and upgrade the shop. Be careful though – some shady individuals may want to steal your precious wares!

[h1][b]Meet the villagers[/b][/h1]
Getting to know Rynoka’s residents and understanding needs of customers is crucial. Some folks may have special quests for you, requesting rare items and offering handsome rewards in return.

[h1][b]Craft & enchant[/b][/h1]
Crafting and enchanting system is essential for the your progression. Interacting with the villagers is the way to craft new armors, weapons and enchant existing equipment. This creates a great deal of flexibility and spices up the way the equipment is used.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28578670/5a047e2229425069019e550de259a19ebb221b73.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Get the loot[/b][/h1]
While visiting other worlds, collect valuable resources, weapons, armors, treasures and peculiar artifacts. Then, manage acquired loot using unique inventory-based abilities.

[h1][b]Fight with style[/b][/h1]
 Defeating various enemies and bosses, revel in the challenging and deep combat mechanics. The depth of combat depends on the interactions between weapons, abilities, enemies and secondary effects of items. Feel comfortable developing your own battling style.

[h1][b]Open the gates[/b][/h1]
Gates lead to different worlds. Each run is unique and forces you to take some smart decisions. You never know what you will encounter next – that’s why you have to be prepared for everything.

---

[b]Game is developed by Digital Sun Games and published by 11 bit studios. We plan to release it in 2017 for Xbox One, PS4, PC, Mac & Linux.[/b]
